provenance.skipped-22s.wav: The long recording of the benchmark (docs/benchmarks/chunked-transcription.md), cut at 77.80 s. At that position whisper does not report a segment for the first 22.08 s of the window, so the pipeline of sprint 6 left the beginning of the recording untranscribed. The audio is the committed fixture speech.wav (5.41 s) repeated.
provenance.varied-speech: Composed at run time from the speech clips of tests/fixtures/boundary. The clips are generated with espeak-ng (en-us, speed 140) and resampled to 16 kHz mono. The reference is the text of the clips in the order they are placed.

cases.name: varied-speech
cases.description: Four windows of speech with different sentences, different gaps and one repetition.
